products.name: FlowSuit Inventory
products.summary: Replace your stock spreadsheet with live inventory your whole team can update.
products.description: FlowSuit Inventory turns the stock register you keep in Excel or a notebook into a shared system: every item, quantity and movement in one place, updated from a phone or a desk.
features: Item list with SKU, cost, price and stock level
Stock in, stock out and transfers between locations
Import your existing Excel or Google Sheets file
use_cases: Shops and wholesalers counting stock by hand

products.name: FlowSuit Finance
products.summary: Digitize your ledger, expenses and invoices so the numbers add up on their own.
products.description: FlowSuit Finance replaces the accounts workbook with proper bookkeeping: income, expenses, receivables and payables recorded once and turned into reports automatically.
features: Income and expense tracking by category
Profit and loss and cash flow reports
use_cases: Small businesses keeping accounts in Excel
Owners who want monthly numbers without waiting for the accountant

products.name: FlowSuit Store
products.summary: Record sales, print receipts and keep stock in sync at the counter or online.
products.description: FlowSuit Store is a simple point of sale and order book that updates your inventory and accounts with every sale, so you stop copying the day's sales into a workbook at night.
features: Connects to FlowSuit Inventory and Finance
Works on a tablet or laptop
use_cases: Businesses taking orders by phone or WhatsApp

products.name: Workbook digitization
products.summary: Send us your Excel workbook or paper register. We turn it into a web app your team can use.
products.description: We take the spreadsheets and registers your business already runs on and rebuild them as a secure web app with logins, forms, validation and reports, keeping the way you already work.
features: Review of your current workbook and process
Forms instead of raw cells, so data is entered correctly
use_cases: A workbook that only one person understands
Several copies of the same file going around by email

products.name: Google Sheets automation
products.summary: Google Apps Script that automates the copy-paste work in your Google Sheets.
products.description: We write Google Apps Script to automate Sheets, Forms, Gmail, Drive and Calendar: scheduled reports, automatic emails, data pulled between sheets and custom menus for your team.
features: Custom buttons and menus inside Sheets
Scheduled jobs that run without you
use_cases: Teams already living in Google Workspace

products.name: Mobile app development
products.summary: Android and iPhone apps for your staff and customers, built on your business data.
products.description: We build mobile apps that connect to your FlowSuit modules or existing data, so field staff, sales teams and customers can work from their phones.
use_cases: Sales and delivery staff on the road
Stock counts on the warehouse floor

products.name: Websites and SEO
products.summary: Fast business websites that are built to be found on Google.
products.description: We build and optimize business websites: clear pages for each product or service, technical SEO, Google Business Profile setup and content that brings in customers.
use_cases: Businesses with no website or an outdated one
Sites that do not show up on Google
